leadMagnet.deliverableHtml:
Courier Startup Checklist

Seven things to have ready before you take your first route as an independent courier:

  1. Vehicle basics. Reliable transportation you can use for deliveries, with routine maintenance up to date.
  2. Insurance basics. Confirm your auto policy covers the driving you plan to do; talk to your agent about commercial or delivery-use coverage.
  3. Business info. Your legal name or business name, address, phone number, and tax information, kept together so carrier applications go smoothly.
  4. Scheduling availability. Know the days and hours you can commit to routes before you start applying.
  5. Communication setup. A working phone number and email you check daily, plus voicemail set up so dispatchers and brokers can reach you.
  6. Paperwork folder. Keep a physical or digital folder with your license, registration, insurance documents, and business info so you can send them on request.
  7. Dispatch support options. Decide whether you want to manage load searching, broker communication, and paperwork yourself, or use a dispatch support service so you can focus on driving.

This checklist is general guidance, not legal, tax, or insurance advice. No earnings are promised or implied.
